text:
sam: quick q — where's the canonical Grafana/dashboard we use to correlate GPU SM% / memory / KV cache hit rate and batch size across prod clusters? trying to dig into a tail latency spike this morning

maria: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/gpu-overview?orgId=1 is the one i usually point folks to. panels for SM%, GPU memory, and a KV cache hit-rate row.

liam: the SM% panel is the heatmap on the top-right (group by instance). if you need a promql for percentile try:
```
avg by (instance)(quantile_over_time(0.95, gpu_sm_utilization[5m]))
```
it's not perfect but helps show 95th across instances.

devin: for KV cache hit rate our metric is `infra_kvcache_hit_ratio`. useful query to overlay with batch size:
```
sum(rate(infra_kvcache_hit_ratio_total[1m])) by (pool) / sum(rate(infra_kvcache_requests_total[1m])) by (pool)
```
then add `avg(batch_size)` as another series.

ops-bot: :warning: ALERT fired — `GPU_SM_util_high` on cluster-west (firing for 7m). Link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/alerts/3245

sam: @liam @aj any quick ideas on alert tuning? SM% alerts are noisy when we spike for <30s during scheduled rollouts.

aj: we moved to a 5m eval window + 90th percentile threshold for prod a while back. if you're getting <1m blips, widen the eval or require sustained >threshold for 3 buckets. e.g. in alert rule set `for: 3m` and use `quantile_over_time(0.9, gpu_sm_utilization[5m]) > 85`.

liam: also consider excluding build/batch jobs by `job=~"(inference|serving)"` filter in the query. dev infra jobs will spike SM but are expected.

tamara: small ask — can we add a panel that shows median batch size vs 95th SM% over the last hour? would help correlate sudden batch changes with SM spikes.

maria: yep can add, i'll make a dashboard PR. will include a panel with two y-axes: median batch size (left) and p95 SM% (right).

devin: optional: add a KV cache hit-rate annotation for recent model rollouts (we tag requests with `model_version`). that way we can visually align drops in hit-rate with deploy times.

sam: perfect. if anyone has a quick query for a panel i can paste into the dashboard PR.

aj: here's a compact set to start with:
```
# p95 SM% by instance
quantile_over_time(0.95, gpu_sm_utilization[5m])

# median batch size
avg_over_time(request_batch_size[5m])

# kv cache hit rate by pool
sum(rate(infra_kvcache_hits[1m])) by (pool) / sum(rate(infra_kvcache_requests[1m])) by (pool)
```

liam: i'll review the PR once maria opens it. small nit: label panels with `cluster` and `instance` so we can filter by region.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Note: scheduled maintenance window for cluster-west today 18:00-19:00 UTC — may explain some short spikes.

sam: ok great — thanks all. i'll start triage with those panels and ping if i need a deeper look. :thumbsup:
